name: sql-job-simulator
description: A simulated data job. Release 1 is one e-commerce project on Postgres.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,proxy -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @sim/server" "npm run dev -w @sim/web" "npm run proxy -w @sim/server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,proxy -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w @sim/server" "npm run start -w @sim/web" "npm run proxy -w @sim/server"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sim/engine && npm run test:e2e -w @sim/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sim/engine && npm run typecheck -w @sim/server && npm run typecheck -w @sim/web
